messages:
Jamie: quick check — we keep hitting blindspots in telemetry when retries interact with paginated calls. are we happy with emitting per-retry-window metrics + per-page boundary events across SDKs? :thinking_face:
Rachel: +1 to visibility. right now we only get total request/response times which hides retry backoff shapes. that makes it hard to tune transport vs. pagination heuristics.
Tom: curious on ergonomics — do we want this surfaced as opt-in debug telemetry or a first-class minimal event set? mobile customers will hate extra noise.
Alex: i'd vote first-class but minimal: emit a short event for each retry attempt and one for page-boundary latency. keep it tiny (enum + ms + retry_reason). users can opt out of detailed payloads.
Jamie: proposed minimal schema (very small):
```json
{"event_type":"retry_attempt","attempt":2,"backoff_ms":500,"reason":"http_5xx","page_cursor":"abc123","latency_ms":120}
```
Jamie: also thinking we should add a transport-level hint so SDKs can route long tail pages to cheaper backends automatically. that requires the runtime to see per-page latency distribution (p50/p95) and retry-window sizes.
Rachel: for Python/TS/Go parity: surface same event names, but allow language SDKs to attach extra fields (e.g., goroutine id in Go for internal debug, node process id for TS). avoid breaking change on schema.
Tom: retention & privacy: remove page_cursor by default or hash it. we must avoid storing PII/IDs in telemetry. agree on hashed_cursor or presence boolean.
Alex: +1. hashed_cursor or cursor_present:true. Also recommend a sampled mode (1% by default) for full telemetry payloads.
Jamie: transport choices: with these events we can implement a smart router that uses recent page latency + retry density to pick GPU-backed or CPU-backend. question: do SDKs compute aggregates locally (and send summaries) or send raw events to control-plane?
Rachel: prefer local aggregation (p50/p95 windows) to reduce telemetry ingestion costs. SDKs can emit summary events every N pages or every M seconds. raw per-retry events kept for sampled traces only.
Alex: small SDK API sketch for config (TS example):
```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  telemetry: {
    enabled: true,
    samplingRate: 0.01,
    emitSummaryEvery: 30_000, // ms
    redactCursor: true
  },
  retry: { maxAttempts: 4, backoffBaseMs: 200 }
});
```
Tom: sounds reasonable. compatibility note: older SDKs won't emit these summaries — control plane must tolerate missing keys.
Jamie: operational follow-up: product/ops can use summarized signals to tune default retry windows and pagination batch sizes, and set policy for routing. put a canary where we route only 5% of traffic based on this feature first.
Rachel: i'll write an RFC addendum with schema + sampling semantics + privacy constraints. will tag eng-ml and infra for routing implications.
ci-bot: deploy-checklist reminder: add telemetry toggle + sampling flags to feature flags service before wide rollout. :memo:
Jamie: thanks — i'll draft the RFC and share a quick benchmark (p50/p95 delta with sampled vs. full). tagging @Tom @Alex for review when ready. :thumbsup:
